title: Feature Selection for Latent Factor Models
abstract: arXiv:2412.10128v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Feature selection is crucial for pinpointing relevant features in high-dimensional datasets, mitigating the 'curse of dimensionality,' and enhancing machine learning performance. Traditional feature selection methods for classification use data from all classes to select features for each class. This paper explores feature selection methods that select features for each class separately, using class models based on low-rank generative methods and introducing a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) feature selection criterion. This novel approach offers a theoretically sound guarantee of feature recovery under specific assumptions and has been demonstrated to outperform some existing feature selection methods on standard classification datasets. Additionally, it can be easily applied in a class-incremental learning setup, yielding performance comparable to that of some current methods.

translated_title: 潜因子模型的特征选择
translated_abstract: 特征选择对于在高维数据集中精确定位相关特征、缓解“维度灾难”以及提升机器学习性能至关重要。传统的分类特征选择方法使用来自所有类别的数据为每个类别选择特征。本文探讨了为每个类别分别选择特征的特征选择方法，该方法使用基于低秩生成方法的类别模型，并引入了信噪比（SNR）特征选择准则。这种新颖的方法在特定假设下为特征恢复提供了理论上的可靠保证，并已被证明在标准分类数据集上优于一些现有的特征选择方法。此外，该方法可以轻松应用于类增量学习设置，其性能与一些现有方法相当。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于低秩生成类模型和信噪比（SNR）准则的按类别分别进行特征选择的新方法，该方法具有理论保证的特征恢复能力，在标准分类数据集上优于部分现有方法，并可轻松应用于类增量学习场景。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel per-class feature selection method based on low-rank generative class models and a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) criterion, which provides theoretical guarantees for feature recovery, outperforms some existing methods on standard classification datasets, and can be readily applied to class-incremental learning.
